derivation:
by
  ext y; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_diff, eq_iff_le_not_lt]
  simp [← WithZero.lt_mul_exp_iff_le (WithZero.exp_ne_zero (a := k - 1)), ← WithZero.exp_add]
explanation: Instantiate the declaration with x = Valued.v y and y = WithZero.exp (k - 1). It identifies valuation < exp k with valuation ≤ exp (k - 1); routine set extensionality and eq_iff_le_not_lt give the result. Its proof is independent.
